library.description: Displays a character's portrait image in a framed viewport; purely visual readout, no interaction.
Horizontal filled bar showing a quantity; fill fraction is value/max clamped to 0-1. Optional segmented rendering for discrete pips.
Compact alphanumeric readout of a single datum (number or text) with optional unit and delta; read-only. Value units are supplied by the component.
Row of active status-effect indicators, each with an id, icon glyph, optional stack count and optional remaining duration in seconds.

props.effects: { id: string; label: string; icon?: string; stacks?: number; remaining?: number; tone?: 'buff' | 'debuff' }[]

library.description: Digital time readout; time is supplied as a preformatted string or epoch milliseconds and ticks only if the component updates it.
Increment/decrement control pair around a numeric value; emits the new value clamped within min..max and stepping by step.
Read-only list of perk entries showing name, tier/rank and locked/unlocked state.

props.perks: { id: string; label: string; description?: string; rank?: number; maxRank?: number; unlocked?: boolean }[]

library.description: Anatomical silhouette surface on which slot elements are placed in normalized 0-1 coordinates of the diagram's own box.

props.points?: { id: string; x: number; y: number }[]

library.description: A single equip socket showing an occupying item (icon, name, rarity, stats) or an empty state; clicking emits the slot id. Position is normalized 0-1 when placed on a surface.

props.item?: { id: string; label: string; icon?: string; rarity?: 'common' | 'uncommon' | 'rare' | 'epic' | 'legendary'; stats?: { label: string; value: string | number }[] }

library.description: Scrollable selectable list of inventory items with multiple fields per row; onChange emits the highlighted item id, onActivate emits an item id to equip/use.

props.items: { id: string; label: string; category?: string; rarity?: 'common' | 'uncommon' | 'rare' | 'epic' | 'legendary'; icon?: string; stats?: { label: string; value: string | number }[]; quantity?: number }[]

library.description: Momentary push button that fires once per press; face content is supplied as children.
Latching two-state control; emits the new on-state when toggled.
Segmented set of mutually exclusive options; emits the selected option id.

props.options: { id: string; label: string; count?: number }[]

library.description: Pannable/zoomable stylized map surface; child markers and routes are placed in normalized 0-1 map coordinates. Emits viewport changes on pan/zoom.

props.onViewportChange: (v: { zoom: number; center: { x: number; y: number } }) => void
props.regions?: { id: string; label: string; x: number; y: number }[]

library.description: A single point marker placed at normalized 0-1 coordinates on a map surface; clicking emits its id.
Polyline overlay drawn on a map surface through a sequence of normalized 0-1 points, optionally highlighted as the active route.
Scrollable selectable list of quest entries with title, objective, district and reward fields; onChange emits the selected quest id.

props.quests: { id: string; title: string; objective?: string; district?: string; category?: string; rewardEddies?: number; rewardStreetCred?: number; tracked?: boolean; completed?: boolean }[]
